subject.title: Doubao/BytePlus model catalog: cacheRead/cacheWrite pricing set to 0, missing context caching cost

question: What vendor-backed cacheRead/cacheWrite mapping should OpenClaw store for BytePlus and Volcengine/Doubao manifests, and should maintainers replace or adopt the stale fork PR path?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but hard-coding provider pricing requires current vendor-proof and a maintainer choice about how cache storage/write charges fit OpenClaw's cost fields.

options.title: Confirm pricing and replace the stale PR
options.body: Use current vendor pricing to update both plugin manifests and tests in a clean same-repository fix, then supersede the conflicting fork PR.

options.title: Adopt and retarget the fork PR
options.body: Ask the fork PR author or a maintainer to move the old core-file patch onto the current plugin manifest surface before review.

options.title: Wait for billing proof
options.body: Keep the issue open without another fix attempt until maintainers can verify cache-hit and cache-storage billing from the vendor console or docs.

recommendation.title: Confirm pricing and replace the stale PR
recommendation.body: Use current vendor pricing to update both plugin manifests and tests in a clean same-repository fix, then supersede the conflicting fork PR.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history ties this person to the current provider manifest surface and related model catalog refactors.
